notes.subject: ⟨em⟩
notes.rationale: Tok Pisin i nidim olgeta nem bilong kisim; עליה i olgeta long wanpela samting (Moab, tok bilong olgeta).

notes.subject: חשבון/חשבו
notes.rationale: Nem bilong ples Heshbon na tok 'ol i tingim' i wankain rot long Hibru — ol i tingim samting nogut 'long ples bilong tingting'.

notes.subject: מדמן/תדמי
notes.rationale: Nem Madmen na tok 'yu bai stap kwait' (דמם) i wankain nois — pasin bilong tok i suave long Nem.

notes.subject: תהלת מואב
notes.rationale: Sampela olsem 'kolim gutpela bilong Moab i pinis', sampela (Geneva) olsem 'Moab i no ken vanityim long Heshbon' — עוד i tanim pasin bilong tok.

translation: I no gat kolim gutpela bilong Moab nau; long Heshbon ol i tingim samting nogut long ⟨em⟩: Kam, yumi rausim ⟨em⟩ i no ken kamap nesen nomo. Tu, Madmen, yu bai stap kwait; bainat bai bihainim yu.
